subject: Biology
title: Cell Cycle and Cell Division
summary: Cell cycle = ek cell ka bada hona, DNA copy karna aur do mein batna. Interphase (G₁ → S → G₂) poore cycle ka 95% se zyada time leta hai; asli division (M phase) chhota hota hai (human cell mein ~1 ghanta, poora cycle ~24 ghante).
S phase mein DNA double hota hai (2C → 4C), lekin chromosome number same rehta hai, kyunki har chromosome mein ab do sister chromatids hain.
Mitosis (equational division): 2n → 2n, do identical cells — growth, repair. Meiosis (reductional division): 2n → n, chaar cells — gametes, aur crossing over se variation.
Exam ka core: mitosis ke har stage ke markers, prophase I ke 5 sub-stages (leptotene, zygotene, pachytene, diplotene, diakinesis), aur har stage par chromosome number aur DNA content.

formulas.name: Phases of the cell cycle
formulas.formula: Interphase = G₁ (growth) → S (DNA synthesis) → G₂ (proteins for mitosis);  M phase = karyokinesis + cytokinesis;  G₀ = quiescent stage
formulas.mistake: G₀ cells metabolically active hote hain, sirf divide nahi karte (jab tak zaroorat na ho).

formulas.name: Duration
formulas.formula: human cell in culture ~24 h (M phase ~1 h);  yeast ~90 min

formulas.name: Meiosis output
formulas.formula: 1 cell (2n) → 4 cells (n);  meiosis I reductional, meiosis II equational (mitosis jaisa)

formulas.name: DNA content and chromosome number
formulas.formula: G₁: 2n, 2C → S/G₂: 2n, 4C → after meiosis I: n, 2C → after meiosis II: n, C
formulas.mistake: Chromosome number sirf meiosis I (anaphase I) mein aadha hota hai, S phase mein nahi badalta.

formulas.name: Cells and divisions
formulas.formula: k rounds ke baad cells = 2ᵏ;   N cells banane ke liye mitotic divisions = N − 1
formulas.note: 128 cells ke liye 7 generations, par divisions 127.

formulas.name: Meiosis counts
formulas.formula: 1 meiosis → 4 pollen grains (ya 4 microspores) → par sirf 1 egg (3 polar bodies/megaspores degenerate);  N pollen ke liye N/4 meiosis;  N eggs ke liye N meiosis

formulas.name: Prophase markers
formulas.formula: chromatin condense hokar chromosomes;  centrosomes opposite poles ki taraf;  end mein nucleolus, Golgi, ER aur nuclear envelope gayab

formulas.name: Metaphase markers
formulas.formula: chromosomes equatorial (metaphase) plate par;  spindle fibres kinetochores se jude;  morphology study ke liye best stage

formulas.name: Anaphase markers
formulas.formula: centromere split, sister chromatids (ab daughter chromosomes) opposite poles ki taraf;  centromere aage, arms peeche

formulas.name: Telophase markers
formulas.formula: chromosomes poles par decondense;  nuclear envelope, nucleolus, Golgi, ER dobara banate hain

formulas.name: Cytokinesis
formulas.formula: animal: cell membrane mein furrow, beech se do;  plant: cell plate (middle lamella) centre se bahar ki taraf;  karyokinesis ke baad cytokinesis na ho ⇒ syncytium (coconut ka liquid endosperm)

formulas.name: Prophase I sub-stages
formulas.formula: Leptotene (chromosomes dikhte hain) → Zygotene (synapsis, synaptonemal complex, bivalent/tetrad) → Pachytene (crossing over, recombination nodules, recombinase) → Diplotene (synaptonemal complex ghulta, chiasmata dikhte hain) → Diakinesis (chiasmata terminalisation, nucleolus aur nuclear envelope gayab)
formulas.mistake: Crossing over pachytene mein, chiasmata diplotene mein dikhte hain — dono alag.

formulas.name: Meiosis I vs II key events
formulas.formula: Anaphase I: homologous chromosomes alag (sister chromatids saath);  interkinesis: DNA replication nahi;  anaphase II: centromere split, sister chromatids alag

examples.title: Har stage ki ginti
examples.problem: Ek cell mein 2n = 16, G₁ mein DNA = 2C. G₂, meiosis I ke baad aur meiosis II ke baad chromosomes aur DNA?
examples.solution: G₂: 16 chromosomes, 4C. Meiosis I ke baad (har cell): 8 chromosomes (har ek mein 2 chromatids), 2C. Meiosis II ke baad: 8 chromosomes, C.

examples.title: Divisions vs generations
examples.problem: Ek cell se 128 cells banane ke liye kitne mitotic generations aur kitne divisions?

examples.title: Pollen ke liye meiosis
examples.problem: 400 pollen grains banane ke liye kitne meiotic divisions?

examples.title: Bivalents
examples.problem: 2n = 32 wale cell ke prophase I mein kitne bivalents (tetrads)?

examples.title: Eggs ke liye meiosis
examples.problem: 100 eggs ke liye kitne meiotic divisions (female)?
examples.solution: Har meiosis se sirf 1 functional egg ⇒ 100.

examples.title: Significance of mitosis
examples.solution: Growth (multicellular organisms), cell repair (gut lining, skin, RBCs ka replacement), nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio bahaal rakhna, aur plants mein apical aur lateral cambium se lagataar growth.

topics.title: Interphase
topics.explain: G₁: cell metabolically active, badhta hai, DNA replicate nahi hota. S: DNA replication; animal cells mein centriole bhi duplicate (cytoplasm mein). G₂: proteins ban-te hain, mitosis ki taiyari. Divide na karne wale cells G₀ (quiescent) mein chale jaate hain — jaise heart cells.

topics.title: Mitosis kahan hota hai
topics.explain: Animals mein mitosis sirf diploid somatic cells mein; plants mein haploid aur diploid dono cells mein ho sakta hai (gametophyte bhi mitosis se banta hai).

topics.title: Significance of meiosis
topics.explain: Sexual reproduction mein har species ka chromosome number generation dar generation same rakhta hai (gametes n, fertilisation se 2n). Crossing over aur independent assortment se genetic variation — evolution ke liye zaroori.

topics.title: Synaptonemal complex aur crossing over
topics.explain: Zygotene mein homologous chromosomes paas aakar synaptonemal complex se jud jaate hain (synapsis). Pachytene mein non-sister chromatids ke beech segments exchange hote hain (crossing over), recombinase enzyme se. Diplotene mein jahan cross hua wahan X-shaped chiasmata dikhte hain.

topics.title: Diplotene ka lamba time
topics.explain: Kuch vertebrates ke oocytes mein diplotene mahino ya saalon tak chal sakta hai.

topics.title: Meiosis II
topics.explain: Interkinesis ke baad bina DNA replication ke meiosis II shuru — yeh mitosis jaisi hai. Anaphase II mein centromere split hota hai aur sister chromatids alag hote hain. End mein chaar haploid cells.

ratta: G₁ → S → G₂ → M;  G₀ quiescent.
S phase: DNA 2C → 4C, chromosome number same.
Human cycle ~24 h, M phase ~1 h;  yeast ~90 min.
Prophase I: Leptotene, Zygotene, Pachytene, Diplotene, Diakinesis.
Synapsis — zygotene;  crossing over — pachytene;  chiasmata — diplotene.
Anaphase I: homologues alag;  anaphase II: sister chromatids alag.
N cells ke liye N − 1 divisions;  N pollen ke liye N/4 meiosis.
